title: locallibrary settings
description: What `locallibrary settings export` writes and `settings import FILE` reads: everything set in a store, and the player's preferences. Each section is as the store keeps it, with empty maps and lists left out. Plugins' secrets are never in it.

my_settings.description: The My Settings profile (`settings set`): the base for every drive, and per-drive overrides by drive id.

name.description: The drive's name when its override was last edited, for display only.

players.description: The player models `check` uses (`players set`): a default, and each library's own by library id.

sections.description: The sections the profile document includes. Left out: the defaults.

pinned.description: Tracks ("Artist - Title") listed first among signature tracks, in order.

genre_aliases.description: Genre text as tagged, and the genre as shown.

player.description: The player's preferences. Where it was (the drive and list open, the queue, its panels, the volume, the output) never goes in.

tags_column.description: The track list's My Tags column.

field_columns.description: The track list's columns of plugins' fields (`sound.bpm`), in order.

auto_cue.description: Start tracks at their first memory cue or beat.

plugin_host.description: locallibrary's own settings for plugins: which analyzer each field role is read from, when a provider's candidate is picked, and whether each check runs.

plugins.description: Each plugin's settings by its id, as it keeps them, with `services.<name>` (a service kept running) and `keys.<name>` (a command's key in the player) among them. A plugin that isn't installed keeps its settings for when it is.

values.description: Settings and their values, as `settings schema` lists them.
